prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1347; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for a parking lot collision. Claimant reports being struck while backing out of a space. Insured vehicle and claimant vehicle both sustained rear-end and rear-quarter damage. Police report not filed; parties exchanged information at the scene. Photos requested from both sides.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from the claimant. Claimant reports neck and lower back pain beginning later that evening, with a back strain diagnosed at urgent care. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and is handling the claim directly. Advised claimant of the right to seek legal counsel and provided the standard claim packet.

Entry 3: Insured's recorded statement obtained. Insured states the vehicle was moving slowly and the impact was minor. Insured disputes the extent of the claimed injury. Scene photos reviewed; visible damage is consistent with a low-speed impact.

Entry 4: Medical records requested from the claimant's urgent care provider, with a signed authorization form sent. Claimant indicated they have been attending physical therapy twice weekly. Requested treatment notes and billing statements to evaluate the injury claim.

Entry 5: Vehicle damage estimates received from both sides and under review. Injury evaluation pending receipt of complete medical records. Claimant contacted to confirm they have no further documentation to submit. Follow-up scheduled to review records once received and to discuss next steps on the bodily injury component.
